home.text: About Us Services Contact ✕ About Us Services Contact Delivering Innovative and Trusted Survey, Subsea and Offshore Solutions Your trusted partner for offshore excellence In today’s dynamic maritime landscape, navigating complex offshore challenges requires a partner you can rely on. SAFEEN Subsea delivers unparalleled subsea services and bespoke solutions to bolster planning, engineering, subsea construction, positioning and installation activities of major offshore EPC projects in the region. Our team of highly skilled professionals work closely with customers to understand their needs, and create tailored solutions to cater to their requirements, driving efficient, innovative results with optimal outcomes. Our seamless project management approach ensures timely execution without compromising on quality. At SAFEEN Subsea, we take pride in our dedication and expertise, making us the trusted choice for subsea operations in the region. Dependable, time-tested capabilities driven by proven expertise Since its inception, SAFEEN Subsea has established itself as a leading provider of subsea services in the region. We leverage our extensive experience, combined with our commitment to innovative technology and rigorous safety standards, to ensure successful project completion, even in the most challenging environments. Our diverse service portfolio covers the full spectrum of offshore and subsea operations, including: • Subsea inspection, pipeline testing, repair, and removal • Jacket inspection, installation, and decommissioning • Hull inspection and rock removal • Pipeline installations and repairs • Air Sat • Inspection repair and maintenance (IRM) • Rig Positioning • Geophysical, Geotechnical, ROV and Topographic Surveys • Mapping • Diving Our Services SAFEEN Subsea delivers data-driven insights, seamless construction support, and meticulous inspection, maintenance and repair solutions. Our commitment to safety and efficiency translates to reduced downtime, extended asset life, and, ultimately, maximises return on investment. To assist subsea engineering and construction activities, we provide geophysical surveys, geotechnical surveys, ROV (Remotely Operated Vehicle) and PRC surveys (Photo Realistic 3D Cloud), diving operations, sopographical Surveys, dimensional control, laser scan and 3D modelling, rig positioning, pipelay and construction support, LIDAR surveys, oceanography and subsea Support installations.
